changes.evidence: Past group told on screen: in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier episode 1 ('New World Order') Raynor tells Bucky 'I was an excellent soldier, so I saw a lot of dead bodies'; she is a former U.S. Army officer, since discharged, now a therapist. owner_calls.question: Add Agatha's original Salem coven (led by her mother Evanora) as a past group before Agatha's coven? The screen never gives it a proper name.
options: Add a past stage before Agatha's coven, named e.g. 'Salem coven' (MCU wiki calls it 'Salemites', from a tie-in DreadIt image), ended when she kills them in 1693
owner_calls.evidence: Agatha All Along episode 5 ('Darkest Hour / Wake Thy Power'): Lilia, Jen and Rio say Agatha killed 'her original coven' by stealing their power because her own mother tried to have her executed; episode 6 shows the Salemites in flashback, and Evanora's spirit possesses Agatha in episode 5. Shown in full in WandaVision episode 8 (1693 trial), where her mother says she betrayed her coven.

owner_calls.question: Add Lilia's childhood coven in Sicily (led by her Maestra, wiped out by a fever) as a past group before Agatha's coven? The screen only calls it 'our coven'.
options: Add a past stage before Agatha's coven, named e.g. "Lilia's Sicilian coven" (MCU wiki: 'Lilia Calderu's Coven'), ended by the fever
owner_calls.evidence: Agatha All Along episode 7 ('Death's Hand in Mine'): in flashbacks Lilia trains with her Maestra in Sicily and says 'Our entire coven wiped out by a fever. I saw it.' (also told in episode 2).
